text: Steenbarger: no. The CNK ADVANCE trigger h1_close_above:bar_high reads 'An hourly close above yesterday's high takes it to the new high.' It carries no volume test, and no seat has answered the clearing condition minervini and I set. In my method a new high on day_vol 0.46 is distribution (C25), and under 1.40 the breakout is unconfirmed, a hard rejection (C16). rs_leadership LEADER is noted; that is not enough. I hold OPPOSE. It clears when the trigger adds 'on 1.4x time-of-day volume' (wyckoff's 'on rising volume' too) and the bar carries it; then I SUPPORT. Market gate DELEGATED.
